posts: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins saw his lead grow in the race for Alaska governor after roughly 5,000 additional ballots were counted.

Democrat Mary Peltola grew her lead over Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan to to 2,517 votes. Tens of thousands of early and absentee ballots have yet to be counted and a winner may not be known until Nov. 18.
Peltola extends lead over Sullivan in Alaska’s U.S. Senate race as ballot-counting continues, reports James Brooks (an account) for @alaskabeacon.com alaskabeacon.com/2026/11/09/p...
Republican Rep. Nick Begich maintained a solid eight-point lead over independent challenger Bill Hill on Monday in the race for Alaska’s lone U.S. House seat.

Democrat Mary Peltola increased her lead over Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan today, when the state Division of Elections updated its count in one of the nation’s most closely watched U.S. Senate races. Peltola now leads by 2,517 first-choice votes. That’s up from the 637 lead she held last week.
